_comment_files: `impl_files` is the whole ssl/ tree PLUS the internal headers that
DEFINE the structs/enums/unions libssl itself implements; `api_headers`
is the public libssl surface under include/openssl/. The two are unioned
into the candidate set, with no implicit directory
walk. Everything this code reaches and does not name - all of
libcrypto, the providers, libc - lands in the `imported` section,
derived.
Classification is DEFINITION-anchored: an entity is targeted iff its
BODY lives in one of these files, or, having no body anywhere, ALL its
declarations do. That is why a header outside ssl/ belongs here only
when its IMPLEMENTORS are - the functions it declares are defined under
ssl/, or the aggregate types it defines have their lifecycle implemented
under ssl/. A header whose types are merely USED by ssl/ reaches the
imported section on its own and must not be named; naming one would
claim bodies this campaign does not own. See the playbook, 'Scope a
target'.
INCLUDED in `api_headers` - public libssl API surface
(include/openssl/): ssl.h (generated from ssl.h.in at configure
time), ssl2.h, ssl3.h, tls1.h, dtls1.h, srtp.h, quic.h, ech.h and the
two sslerr headers - every one of them declares SSL / SSL_CTX /
SSL_SESSION / SRTP / ECHSTORE surface implemented in ssl/.
INCLUDED in `impl_files` - the ssl/ tree, plus the libssl-implemented
internals (include/internal/): statem.h, ssl.h, ssl_unwrap.h,
ssl3_cbc.h, recordmethod.h (OSSL_RECORD_METHOD is implemented by
ssl/record/methods/*.c), dane.h (SSL_DANE lives inside SSL_CTX and is
driven from ssl/ssl_lib.c), ech_helpers.h (ssl/ech/ech_helper.c),
priority_queue.h (stem partner of ssl/priority_queue.c), uint_set.h,
json_enc.h, qlog*.h, rio_notifier.h and every quic_*.h - all
implemented under ssl/quic/ or ssl/rio/.
EXCLUDED - consumers / referencers whose implementors live in crypto/ or
providers/, so they reach the imported section on their own: packet.h
and packet_quic.h and quic_vlint.h (crypto/packet.c,
crypto/quic_vlint.c - compiled INTO libssl for shared builds but owned
by libcrypto), sslconf.h (crypto/conf/), time.h, bio.h, comp.h,
refcount.h, cryptlib.h, thread*.h, ring_buf.h, list.h and ktls.h
(generic/kernel shims shared with crypto/), tlsgroups.h and
openssl/prov_ssl.h (constant tables shared with providers/).
_comment_out_of_scope: `paths` - nothing under the target set is excluded: every ssl/ source file
compiles into libssl in this configuration. `features` - build.json's
configure command selects no-deprecated; nothing target-local to add
